units.name: CO2 feed compressor
units.purpose: Compress fresh captured CO2 from the battery-limit pressure to reactor pressure.

units.name: H2 feed compressor
units.purpose: Compress fresh hydrogen from the battery-limit pressure to reactor pressure.

units.name: Feed mixer
units.purpose: Combine fresh CO2, fresh H2 and compressed recycle gas at the selected stoichiometric feed ratio.

units.name: Feed-effluent heat exchanger
units.purpose: Recover sensible heat from reactor effluent to preheat the mixed reactor feed.

units.name: Electric trim preheater
units.purpose: Supply only the residual sensible heat needed to reach catalyst inlet temperature, including startup capability.

units.name: Cooled fixed-bed reactor
units.purpose: Convert CO2 and H2 to methanol and water while removing exothermic reaction heat by boiling-water cooling.

units.name: Effluent condenser and knockout
units.purpose: Cool reactor effluent and condense crude methanol, water and a small pressure-dependent dissolved CO2 load from unreacted gas and CO byproduct.

units.name: Recycle purge splitter
units.purpose: Purge CO and feed impurities while returning most uncondensed CO2 and H2 to the reactor loop.

units.name: Recycle compressor
units.purpose: Restore recycle gas pressure after loop pressure drop.

units.name: Methanol purification column
units.purpose: Purify condensed crude methanol to the product specification and reject reaction water, methanol loss and dissolved CO2.

units.name: Methanol product pump
units.purpose: Deliver liquid methanol from column pressure to the specified product battery-limit pressure.

units.name: Product storage and offsites
units.purpose: Provide product storage, cooling-water circulation, electrical distribution and balance-of-plant services.

catalyst_regeneration.excluded: No common in-situ regeneration protocol is supported across the diverse catalyst literature; catalyst decay is represented by replacement and average-cycle inventory instead.
